items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued September 17 at 6:02AM AKDT until September 17 at 9:00AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...Western Kupreanof Island and Kuiu Island.

* WHEN...Until 9 AM AKDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make travel conditions hazardous.
items.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued September 16 at 2:12PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
ESFAFG

...Locations Impacted...
Upper Kuskokwim Valley

Recent heavy rains have fallen across Western Alaska. Water levels
along streams and rivers will continue to slowly recede through
Wednesday night then slowly rise again Thursday morning as the
rainfall from the recent Bering storm moves downstream. Water levels
this weekend are not expected to be as high in comparison to last
week.

For more updated river information, please refer to water.noaa.gov or
weather.gov/aprfc.
